rows.en: Listen up, everyone!! We commence the mission in Formation E!
Roger!!
...Ngh. But this isn't over yet.
Captain Masurao is taking part in this tournament as well...
Mark my words, you'll be... crushed!!
So you're our opponents!!
We are an elite unit formed to thoroughly investigate, capture and eliminate Gundams!
An elite unit that specializes in Gundams...?
An elite unit that specializes in Gundams...?
An elite unit that specializes in Gundams...?
So there you are! Gundaaam!!
But you don't seem to be a Gundam I know. In that case, allow me to say it anyway!
Pleased to meet you, Gundam!
Listen up, everyone!! We commence the mission in Formation E!
Roger!!
...Ngh. But this isn't over yet.
Captain Masurao is taking part in this tournament as well...
Mark my words, you'll be... crushed!!
So you're our opponents!!
We are an elite unit formed to thoroughly investigate, capture and eliminate Gundams!
I was hoping I'd get to meet a Gundam, but what a pity.
Even so, we'll still score a victory, just watch!
All right, everyone!! We commence the mission in Formation E!
Roger!!
...Ngh. But this isn't over yet.
Captain Masurao is taking part in this tournament as well...
You lot could never... hope to match him...
You're bound to run into him sooner or later...!!
The next match details appeared on the monitor.
Opponent: Jashrine\nVenue: Floor 1 SE, City District A
Venue: Floor 1 SE, City District A
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Jashrine...
Notorious villains who have been ravaging the universe...
I've heard that they collect the corpses of those they defeat and turn them into golden statues.
You're... God Gundam!!
You're... God Gundam!!
You're... God Gundam!!
You're... God Gundam!!
If I remember right... you're God Gundam!!
If I'm not mistaken... you're God Gundam...!!
Ah...!! You're God Gundam!!
Why, you're God Gundam!!
Oh! Whoa!! You're that God Gundam guy, ain'tcha!
You're God Gundam!!
You're God Gundam!!
So it's you lot. We meet again...
What are you doing here?
...I was entered into this tournament without even knowing it myself.
I could've ignored it, but once I heard Master Gundam was the organizer, I chose to enter.
He's become enthralled by the power of the Devil Gundam.
If he's here, there's a good chance the Devil Gundam is in this Cube as well.
Sorry, but my next fight is about to start. I'll see you in the finals.
You! You called yourself God Gundam or something, right?
So it's you lot. We meet again...
What are you doing here?
...I was entered into this tournament without even knowing it myself.
I could've ignored it, but once I heard Master Gundam was the organizer, I chose to enter.
He's become enthralled by the power of the Devil Gundam.
If he's here, there's a good chance the Devil Gundam is in this Cube as well.
So this is the match venue... You ready?
Tch, we don't have time to spare. Hurry it up.
Nothing overlooked, right?
...!! Here they come!!
Against us, tearing down the road of an unbroken winning streak in space street fights...
...some fool actually means to put up a fight, it seems-jaja.
We'll make you feel... just how strong we are-shura.
Leave it to me-een!
So each of those three faces has its own personality?
What a cheeky punk-shura!!
We'll turn you into a golden statue too-een!
You're going into our collection, that's final-jaja!!
Jaaa-jajja-jaaa-jja-jaaa!
Shura-shura~♪
Eeeeen!!
Tch, they're making fools of us...
Hey! Let's wrap this up fast!!
We did it!

notes.note: 0418 has three branches by party: #0.10-0.22 (00 present, Graham-style 'I want to embrace you'), #0.30-0.43 (other Gundam: script checks Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero), #0.47-0.57 (no Gundam). The Over Flag leader speaks; #0.18 'Roger!!' is the other Over Flags in chorus.
'Masurao taichou' = Mr. Bushido by machine name, so 'Captain Masurao'.

Subject of 'tataki tsubushite kureru' is ambiguous (the defeated pilot's own vow, or Captain Masurao from the previous row). Kept the ambiguity with a passive; the ellipsis placement follows the source. Same for #0.43.
#0.32-0.34 are identical leader variants (Nu, Zeta, Wing Zero per the 0418 Pt_Chara_Check order); identical English.
Parody of Graham Aker's 'aete iwasete morau' lines; 'Pleased to meet you, Gundam!' (#0.37) answers his famous 'I want to embrace you, Gundam!' from the 00 branch.
'Senka wa agete miseru' (I will still earn battle results) rendered as 'we'll still score a victory'; 'we' for the squad leader speaking for the unit.
No-Gundam branch: 'him' = Captain Masurao from #0.55. #0.57 has no speaker label but continues the same Over Flag.

Deliberate two-line layout kept. 'Dai-1-sou' rendered 'Floor 1', 'nantou' abbreviated 'SE' for width; 'shigaichi A chiku' = 'City District A'. Should match story_071/073's renderings of the same match-board rows.
Jashrine is a trio, so 'villains' and 'they' (plural) rather than a singular pronoun.

#0.2-0.12 are 11 leader variants. 0420.bla Pt_Chara_Check order 6,7,10,9,15,14,5,4,3,2,1 = Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Rider 1. Voices match: polite Mebius #0.7 and OOO #0.8 ('-san' dropped, politeness in tone), W #0.9 uses Philip's 'kimi', Momotaros #0.10 rough.
Ankh's line plays when no listed leader matches (script order: leader variant, then this). Rows #0.23 and #0.25-0.30 are unlabelled duplicates of #0.1/#0.13-0.18 and get the same English.
'Yatsu' = Master Gundam (male per glossary), so 'he'. 'Shinsui' = enthralled/devoted.
Yes/No prompt; 0422.bla shows Ankh's name box (CHARA_NAME 36). #0.5 is Ankh after 'No'. #0.8 has no name box (after CharaNameOut); worded as a confirmation, likely Ankh's voice.
One sentence split across #0.10/#0.11 (Jaja head, 'oresamara'); English cut at the matching point. Suffixes per glossary: -jaja (#0.11, #0.17), -shura (#0.12, #0.15), -een (#0.13, #0.16).
Trio's laugh: each head's verbal tic as a laugh ('Jaaa-jajja...', 'Shura-shura~', 'Eeeeen!!'); the music note is kept as in source.
First of 13 victory variants (0422.bla order 14,15,12,11,5,4,3,2,1,6,7,9,10): this one is Mebius. The rest are in story_073.

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader-variant orders taken from 0418/0420/0422.bla Pt_Chara_Check runs and confirmed by voice. Uncertain: 0418 #0.22/#0.43 subject of 'will crush you' (pilot or Captain Masurao), kept ambiguous with a passive; 0422 #0.8 unlabelled speaker (likely Ankh). Not in glossary: Overflags (unit, not named in this slice), 'Captain Masurao', match-board terms 'Floor 1 SE, City District A' (should match 071/073).
